orderedStages.title: Freeze the current pack and approved change
orderedStages.input: Actual baseline copy, stable surface IDs and explicit old/new values with variant and effective time.
orderedStages.method: Build a baseline manifest and exact change card. Separate a proposed future change from a live current fact. Map direct mentions, dependent arithmetic, terms, CTA destinations and rendered text needing replacement. Keep inaccessible assets unresolved rather than declaring them unchanged.
orderedStages.output: A scoped impact map with affected fields, dependencies, unchanged locks and unresolved assets.
orderedStages.gate: An ambiguous variant, unapproved new value or unknown effective boundary blocks that change; unrelated safe mapping may continue.

orderedStages.title: Check only the evidence that the change affects
orderedStages.input: Change/impact map and evidence records used by affected claims or terms.
orderedStages.method: Review whether each affected source applies to this variant, audience and date. A stale or withdrawn proof record cannot travel as a current claim. Distinguish owner-confirmed product facts from researched estimates. Do not browse unrelated private documents or re-onboard the entire business.
orderedStages.output: A per-claim current, review-needed or withdrawn decision with source and next action.
orderedStages.gate: A missing or withdrawn support record blocks the dependent assertion; a neutral factual rewrite may still be drafted without it.

orderedStages.title: Approve the wording boundary before rewriting
orderedStages.input: Affected statements, new fact/offer card and evidence decisions.
orderedStages.method: Pair every new assertion and condition with its supporting fact. Recompute only affected arithmetic, showing inputs and units. Retain legal/offer qualifiers intact. Do not substitute a more persuasive claim or infer a new discount, guarantee or testimonial.
orderedStages.output: A claim decision register and exact allowed wording/terms for each affected surface.
orderedStages.gate: Unsupported assertions are removed or left blocked; no invented value fills them.

orderedStages.title: Patch the affected copy by surface
orderedStages.input: Baseline copy, allowed changed wording, surface-specific context and unchanged locks.
orderedStages.method: Run only the writer branch needed for an affected ad, email or page. Supply the actual baseline and request a bounded patch, not a fresh concept round. Preserve approved voice, language, audience, layout role and all unaffected facts. Return a minimal snippet with placement or a requested full-file replacement and a change log.
orderedStages.output: Versioned proposed copy and an affected-field diff; unaffected surfaces remain explicitly unchanged.
orderedStages.gate: A missing baseline prevents a safe replacement for that surface. Return the needed snippet or slot without claiming the unseen file was updated.

orderedStages.title: Review the actual patched pack and prepare release
orderedStages.input: Original and revised copy, claim register, impact map and destination/version manifest.
orderedStages.method: Compare every changed field against the approved card and review cross-surface consistency. Confirm dependent prices, dates, exclusions and CTA promises agree. Recheck unchanged locks for accidental drift. Build a publisher handoff listing exact old/new versions, effective time, destinations, approval scope and rollback copy. Check rendered/live states only with actual tools and access; chat copy review is not that evidence.
orderedStages.output: A text review, unresolved production/destination checks and the exact-version handoff.
orderedStages.gate: Unresolved material claims, stale target versions or unverified critical destination behavior block activation. Reuse existing authorization for any permitted next action; do not claim publication from the handoff alone.
